title: Procedure Text
ringkas: Instruksi langkah demi langkah dan kalimat perintah
goals: memakai **kalimat perintah** (imperative) positif dan negatif untuk memberi instruksi
menjelaskan tujuan dan batas waktu dengan [[to + kata kerja]], [[until]], dan [[so that]]
membaca dan menulis petunjuk membuat, memakai, atau melakukan sesuatu

lesson.text: Resep masakan, cara memakai mesin fotokopi, cara mendaftar akun online. Semuanya adalah **procedure text**, yaitu teks yang menjelaskan **bagaimana cara** membuat atau melakukan sesuatu melalui **langkah-langkah** yang berurutan. Di kelas 8 kamu sudah mengenal dasarnya. Sekarang kamu belajar menyusunnya dengan rapi dan lengkap.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur procedure text
table: Tujuan atau judul: apa yang akan dibuat atau dilakukan
[[2 eggs, a pinch of salt, 1 tablespoon of oil]]
[[First, crack the eggs into a bowl. Next, add the salt ...]]

lesson.title: 2. Ciri kebahasaan
table: [[two cups of water]], [[a teaspoon of salt]]

items.ex: Mix the flour and the eggs.
Pour the water into the glass.
Boil the eggs for ten minutes.
Fry the rice for five minutes.

lesson.title: 4. Kalimat perintah
lesson.text: Kalimat perintah memakai **kata kerja bentuk dasar** tanpa subjek. Untuk larangan, tambahkan **Don't**. Untuk lebih sopan, tambahkan **please**.
table: [[Make sure the machine is off.]] / [[Be careful not to spill the water.]]

lesson.title: Jangan pakai subjek atau -ing
lesson.text: Benar: [[Add the salt.]] Salah: *You adding the salt.* dan *Adds the salt.* Pakai kata kerja **bentuk dasar**.

lesson.title: 5. Tujuan dan batas waktu
table: [[Use a knife to slice the onion.]]
[[Stir the soup so that it doesn't burn.]]

lesson.title: 6. into, to, through, over, dan in dalam instruksi
lesson.text: Dalam procedure text, preposisi menunjukkan **ke mana** sesuatu dipindahkan:
table: [[Put the egg in the bowl.]] / [[Put the plate on the table.]]

examples.en: [[Pour the milk into the bowl, add sugar to it, and stir.]]
examples.id: Tuang susu ke mangkuk, tambahkan gula padanya, lalu aduk.

examples.en: [[Cut the bread into slices and spread butter over each slice.]]
examples.id: Potong roti menjadi irisan dan oleskan mentega di atas tiap irisan.

lesson.title: Jangan tertukar: into dan to
lesson.text: Katakan [[Add sugar to the tea.]], bukan ~~add sugar into the tea~~, dan [[Pour water into the glass.]], bukan ~~pour water to the glass~~.

lesson.title: 8. Pasif dalam procedure text
lesson.text: Selain perintah, procedure text memakai pasif untuk menjelaskan urutan langkah:

examples.en: [[First, the tire is removed. Next, the new one is fitted.]]
examples.id: Pertama, ban dilepas. Berikutnya, ban baru dipasang.

lesson.title: 9. Menyatakan tujuan: to V1, in order to, so as to
lesson.text: Untuk menjelaskan tujuan sebuah langkah, pakai **to + V1**.
table: [[Use a knife to cut the bread.]]
[[Boil the water in order to kill the germs.]]
[[Stir slowly so as to avoid spilling.]]
[[A kettle is used for boiling water.]]

examples.en: [[Press the button to turn on the machine, and wait for a minute to let it warm up.]]
examples.id: Tekan tombol untuk menyalakan mesin, dan tunggu semenit agar mesin menghangat.

lesson.title: Tujuan: to V1, fungsi benda: for V-ing
lesson.text: Katakan [[I use a spoon to stir.]] atau [[A spoon is used for stirring.]] Jangan campur: ~~I use a spoon for to stir~~.

lesson.title: Teks 1: How to Make Scrambled Eggs

lines.en: You need two eggs, a pinch of salt, one tablespoon of oil, and a little pepper.
lines.id: Kamu membutuhkan dua butir telur, sejumput garam, satu sendok makan minyak, dan sedikit merica.

lines.en: First, crack the eggs into a bowl. Next, add the salt and the pepper, then beat the eggs with a fork.
lines.id: Pertama, pecahkan telur ke dalam mangkuk. Selanjutnya, tambahkan garam dan merica, lalu kocok telur dengan garpu.

lines.en: Then heat the oil in a pan over low heat. Pour the eggs into the pan and stir slowly until they are soft and yellow.
lines.id: Lalu panaskan minyak di wajan dengan api kecil. Tuangkan telur ke wajan dan aduk perlahan sampai lembut dan kuning.

lines.en: Finally, put the eggs on a plate and serve them hot. Be careful. The pan is hot.
lines.id: Terakhir, taruh telur di piring dan sajikan selagi hangat. Hati-hati, wajannya panas.

lesson.title: Teks 2: How to Join an Online Class

lines.en: How to Join an Online Class
You need a laptop or a phone, a stable internet connection, and the class link.
lines.id: Kamu membutuhkan laptop atau ponsel, koneksi internet yang stabil, dan tautan kelas.

lines.en: First, open the link from your teacher. Second, type your full name and click the Join button.
lines.id: Pertama, buka tautan dari gurumu. Kedua, ketik nama lengkapmu dan klik tombol Join.

lines.en: Next, allow the app to use your microphone and your camera. Make sure your microphone is off until the teacher asks you to speak.
lines.id: Selanjutnya, izinkan aplikasi memakai mikrofon dan kameramu. Pastikan mikrofonmu mati sampai guru memintamu berbicara.

lines.en: Finally, wait for the class to begin. Don't forget to turn off your microphone when you finish speaking.
lines.id: Terakhir, tunggu sampai kelas dimulai. Jangan lupa mematikan mikrofon setelah selesai berbicara.

lines.en: Dina, how do I use the photocopy machine? I have never used it.
lines.id: Dina, bagaimana cara memakai mesin fotokopi? Aku belum pernah memakainya.

lines.en: It's easy. First, lift the cover and put your paper face down on the glass.
lines.id: Mudah. Pertama, angkat penutup dan taruh kertasmu menghadap ke bawah di atas kaca.

lines.en: Close the cover, choose the number of copies, and press the green button. Don't open the cover while the machine is working.
lines.id: Tutup penutupnya, pilih jumlah salinan, dan tekan tombol hijau. Jangan buka penutup saat mesin bekerja.

Nasi goreng adalah hidangan populer di Indonesia. Begini cara membuatnya untuk dua orang.
Bahan: dua piring nasi dingin, dua butir telur, tiga siung bawang putih, satu sendok makan kecap manis, dan sedikit minyak. Langkah: Pertama, cincang halus bawang putih. Berikutnya, panaskan minyak di wajan dan tumis bawang putih hingga harum. Lalu, masukkan telur dan aduk. Setelah itu, masukkan nasi dan kecap. Aduk rata selama lima menit. Terakhir, sajikan selagi panas.

read.text:
Fried rice is a popular dish in Indonesia. Here is how to make it for two people.
Ingredients: two plates of cold rice, two eggs, three cloves of garlic, one tablespoon of sweet soy sauce, and some oil. Steps: First, chop the garlic finely. Next, heat the oil in a pan and fry the garlic until it smells good. Then, add the eggs and stir them. After that, add the rice and the soy sauce. Mix everything well for five minutes. Finally, serve it while it is hot.
read.title: How to Make Fried Rice

What do you do at the end?

read.text:
Using a water dispenser is easy. First, make sure your glass is clean. Put the glass under the tap. Second, choose the water temperature. Press the blue button for cold water or the red button for hot water.
Be careful with hot water. Don't fill the glass to the top. Third, press the button and wait until the glass is almost full. Then release the button. Finally, wipe the spilled water with a cloth.
read.title: How to Use a Water Dispenser

read.id:
Pancake mudah dibuat. Kamu butuh tepung, dua telur, susu, sedikit gula, dan mentega. Kamu juga butuh mangkuk, sendok, dan wajan.
Pertama, campurkan tepung dan gula di mangkuk. Lalu tambahkan telur dan susu, dan aduk sampai adonan halus. Panaskan wajan dan lelehkan sedikit mentega. Tuang sedikit adonan ke wajan. Ketika gelembung muncul, balikkan pancake. Masak satu menit lagi, dan sajikan hangat.

qs.exp: Teks: "When bubbles appear, turn the pancake over."
qs.q: When do you turn the pancake over?

qs.exp: Teks: "stir until the mixture is smooth".
options: Heat the pan and melt a little butter
Serve it warm with some fruit
Add butter and sugar to the bowl
qs.q: What do you do after adding the eggs and milk?

options: Pour some mixture into the pan.
Pancakes are easy to make at home.
You need flour, eggs, and milk.
The pan is hot, so be careful.
qs.q: Which sentence is an imperative?
Pasangkan alat dengan fungsinya:
___ the flour and sugar in the bowl. (campurkan)
___ the pancake over when bubbles appear. (balikkan)

qs.answer: Serve it while it is warm.
qs.exp: Imperatif: kata kerja dasar di awal.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Sajikan selagi hangat."

read.text:
Pancakes are easy to make. You need flour, two eggs, milk, a little sugar, and butter. You also need a bowl, a spoon, and a frying pan.
First, mix the flour and sugar in the bowl. Then add the eggs and milk, and stir until the mixture is smooth. Heat the pan and melt a little butter. Pour some mixture into the pan. When bubbles appear, turn the pancake over. Cook it for one more minute, and serve it warm.
read.title: How to Make Pancakes

read.id:
Telur rebus mudah dimasak. Pertama, letakkan telur dengan hati-hati ke dalam panci dan tutupi dengan air dingin. Panaskan air dengan api sedang. Ketika air mendidih, matikan kompor.
Telur dibiarkan di air panas selama sepuluh menit. Lalu telur dipindahkan ke mangkuk berisi air dingin, dan dikupas dengan hati-hati. Telur disajikan dengan garam dan sedikit merica. Jangan pernah memakai telur yang retak, karena bisa pecah di dalam air.

qs.exp: Teks: "left in the hot water for ten minutes".
qs.q: How long are the eggs left in the hot water?

options: The eggs is served with salt.
The eggs are served with salt.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Teks: "because it can break in the water".
options: It can break in the water.
It tastes sweet and is too hard to eat.
It is too hard and takes more time.
It costs more than a normal egg.
qs.q: Why shouldn't you use a cracked egg?
Pasangkan kata kerja dengan past participle:
The eggs ___ (leave) in the hot water for ten minutes.
___ use a cracked egg.

qs.answer: The eggs are served with salt.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Telur disajikan dengan garam."

read.text:
Boiled eggs are easy to cook. First, put the eggs gently into a pan and cover them with cold water. Heat the water on medium heat. When the water boils, turn off the stove.
The eggs are left in the hot water for ten minutes. Then they are moved to a bowl of cold water, and they are peeled carefully. The eggs are served with salt and a little pepper. Never use a cracked egg, because it can break in the water.
read.title: How to Make Boiled Eggs

read.focus: Zero dan first conditional dalam instruksi
read.id:
Rani: Laptopku tidak berfungsi. Apa yang harus kulakukan? Pak Adi: Jika layarnya gelap, periksa kabelnya dulu. Jika kabelnya longgar, colokkan dengan kuat. Rani: Dan jika itu tidak membantu?
Pak Adi: Jika kamu menekan dan menahan tombol daya selama sepuluh detik, laptop akan menyala ulang. Jika masih tidak menyala, telepon teknisi. Bapak akan memberimu nomornya jika kamu butuh. Rani: Terima kasih! Aku akan mencoba kabelnya dulu.

qs.q: What should Rani check first?

options: If the cable will be loose, plug it in.
If the cable is loose, plug it in.
If the screen is dark, check the cable.
If it still doesn't start, call the technician.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
What happens if you hold the power button for ten seconds?

pairs: If the screen is dark, check the cable.
If you hold the button, the laptop restarts.
If it doesn't start, call the technician.
I will give you the number if you need it.
qs.q: Pasangkan kalimat if dengan fungsinya:
If the screen ___ (be) dark, check the cable.
If you press the button for ten seconds, the laptop ___ (restart).
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Colokkan dengan kuat."

read.text:
Rani: My laptop doesn't work. What should I do? Mr. Adi: If the screen is dark, check the cable first. If the cable is loose, plug it in firmly. Rani: And if that doesn't help?
Mr. Adi: If you press and hold the power button for ten seconds, the laptop restarts. If it still doesn't start, call the technician. I will give you his number if you need it. Rani: Thank you! I'll try the cable first.
read.title: If the Screen Is Dark

read.focus: Preposisi prosedur: in, on, into, through, over, under
read.id:
Penjaga: Pertama, pilih tempat datar di atas tanah. Letakkan tas tenda di atas rumput dan keluarkan semuanya dari dalamnya. Lalu bentangkan alas di bawah tenda, dan hamparkan tenda di atas alas.
Penjaga: Dorong tiangnya melalui lubang, dan tancapkan pasak tenda ke dalam tanah dengan palu. Terakhir, taruh kantong tidurmu di dalam tenda. Jika hujan, taruh sepatumu di bawah penutup. Pemandu: Terima kasih atas petunjuknya.

qs.exp: Ranger: "lay the sheet under the tent".
qs.q: Where should you put the sheet?

options: Put the tent pegs in the ground with a hammer.
Put the tent pegs into the ground with a hammer.
Push the poles through the loops.
Place your sleeping bag inside the tent.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Spread the tent ___ the sheet."
Pasangkan preposisi dengan artinya:
Lay the sheet ___ the tent.
Push the poles ___ the loops.

qs.answer: Place your sleeping bag inside the tent.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Letakkan kantong tidurmu di dalam tenda."

read.text:
Ranger: First, choose a flat place on the ground. Put the tent bag on the grass and take everything out of it. Then lay the sheet under the tent, and spread the tent over the sheet.
Ranger: Push the poles through the loops, and put the tent pegs into the ground with a hammer. Finally, place your sleeping bag inside the tent. If it rains, put your shoes under the cover. Camper: Thank you for the instructions.
read.title: Setting Up a Tent

read.focus: Articles dalam prosedur: a, an, the
read.id:
Rani: Pertama, ambil selembar kertas. Lipat kertasnya menjadi dua. Lalu lipat sudut atas ke tengah sehingga membentuk segitiga. Dina: Apakah aku perlu pulpen? Rani: Tidak, kamu tidak perlu pulpen. Kamu hanya perlu kertasnya.
Rani: Berikutnya, lipat tepi bawah ke atas di kedua sisi. Buka bentuknya dan tekan sampai rata. Sekarang kamu punya perahu kecil! Taruh di mangkuk berisi air. Dina: Perahunya mengapung! Permainan yang mudah sekali!

qs.q: What do you need to make the boat?

options: Put it in a bowl of water.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: easy diawali vokal → What an easy game!
qs.q: Choose the correct article: "What ___ easy game!"
Pasangkan frasa dengan aturannya:

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan a, an, atau the:
qs.q: Take ___ sheet of paper.

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan a, an, atau the:
qs.q: Fold ___ paper in half.

qs.answer: Put it in a bowl of water.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Taruh di mangkuk berisi air."

read.text:
Rani: First, take a sheet of paper. Fold the paper in half. Then fold the top corners to the middle to make a triangle. Dina: Do I need a pen? Rani: No, you don't need a pen. You need only the paper.
Rani: Next, fold up the bottom edge on both sides. Open the shape and press it flat. Now you have a small boat! Put it in a bowl of water. Dina: It floats! What an easy game!
read.title: Make a Paper Boat

read.focus: Preposisi gerak dalam prosedur: into, out of, over, through, off, onto
read.id:
Pertama, isi ember dengan air dan masukkan sedikit sabun. Ambil spons dari ember dan gosok mobil dari atap turun ke roda. Tuang air bersih di atas mobil untuk membilas sabun.
Berikutnya, ambil kain lembut dan lap air dari kaca. Jangan biarkan air mengalir masuk ke pintu. Kendarai mobil keluar dari tempat teduh ke bawah matahari agar kering. Terakhir, kembalikan alat ke dalam kotak dan bawa ke garasi.

qs.exp: Teks: "Take a sponge out of the bucket and rub the car".
qs.q: What do you use to rub the car?

options: Take a sponge out the bucket.
Take a sponge out of the bucket.
Pour clean water over the car.
Carry the box to the garage.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Put a little soap ___ the bucket. (ke dalam)"
Pasangkan frasa dengan artinya:
Put a little soap ___ the bucket. (ke dalam)
Pour clean water ___ the car. (di atas)

qs.answer: Carry the box to the garage.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Bawa kotak itu ke garasi."

read.text:
First, fill a bucket with water and put a little soap into it. Take a sponge out of the bucket and rub the car from the roof down to the wheels. Pour clean water over the car to rinse off the soap.
Next, take a soft cloth and wipe the water off the windows. Do not let water run into the door. Drive the car out of the shade into the sun to dry it. Finally, put the tools back into the box and carry it to the garage.
read.title: How to Wash a Car

read.id: Pertama, rebus sedikit air. Lalu masukkan beberapa daun teh ke dalam cangkir. Jangan memakai terlalu banyak air, atau tehnya akan encer. Tambahkan sedikit gula jika kamu mau. Kamu tidak perlu susu. Tunggu beberapa menit sebelum meminumnya.

qs.exp: Teks: "or the tea will be weak".
qs.q: What happens if you use too much water?

options: Put a little tea leaves in a cup.
Put a few tea leaves in a cup.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Add a ___ sugar if you like."
You don't need ___ milk.
Don't use too ___ water.

qs.answer: Wait a few minutes before you drink it.
qs.exp: Urutan: Wait a few minutes before you drink it.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Tunggu beberapa menit sebelum meminumnya."

read.text: First, boil some water. Then put a few tea leaves in a cup. Don't use too much water, or the tea will be weak. Add a little sugar if you like. You don't need any milk. Wait a few minutes before you drink it.
read.title: How to Make Tea

read.focus: Conjunction: and, but, so, because, although, when, while
read.id: Pertama, isi ember dengan air, dan tambahkan sedikit sabun. Lalu basahi mobil, tetapi jangan memakai terlalu banyak air. Lap mobil dengan spons karena spons membersihkan kotoran. Ketika mobil sudah bersih, bilas. Terakhir, keringkan dengan kain supaya tidak ada noda.

options: It saves a lot of water.
It adds soap to the bucket.
qs.q: Why should you wipe the car with a sponge?

options: Wet the car, so do not use too much water.
Wet the car, but do not use too much water.
Rinse it when the car is clean.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Wipe the car with a sponge ___ it removes the dirt."
___ the car is clean, rinse it.
Fill a bucket with water, ___ add some soap.

qs.answer: Finally, dry it with a cloth.
qs.exp: Urutan: Finally, dry it with a cloth.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Terakhir, keringkan dengan kain."

read.text: First, fill a bucket with water, and add some soap. Then wet the car, but do not use too much water. Wipe the car with a sponge because it removes the dirt. When the car is clean, rinse it. Finally, dry it with a cloth so that it does not get spots.
read.title: How to Wash a Car

read.focus: Modal verbs: must, should, could, might, may, can't
read.id: Pertama, kamu harus memarkir di jalan yang datar. Berikutnya, kamu sebaiknya menyalakan lampu darurat. Kamu bisa mengendurkan mur dengan kunci pas, tetapi jangan melepasnya dulu. Setelah itu, kamu boleh mengangkat mobil. Hati-hati, karena mobil bisa jatuh.

qs.q: Why must you be careful?

options: You mustn't to remove them yet.
You must park on a flat road.
You should turn on the warning lights.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "You ___ park on a flat road. (harus)"
You ___ remove the nuts yet. (dilarang)
The car ___ fall. (mungkin)

qs.answer: You should turn on the warning lights.
qs.exp: Urutan: You should turn on the warning lights.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Kamu sebaiknya menyalakan lampu darurat."

read.text: First, you must park on a flat road. Next, you should turn on the warning lights. You can loosen the nuts with a wrench, but you mustn't remove them yet. After that, you may lift the car. Be careful, because the car might fall.
read.title: How to Change a Tire

read.focus: Relative clauses: who, which, that, whose, where
read.id: Rebus air dalam ketel yang punya tutup. Pakai cangkir yang bersih. Tambahkan daun teh yang kering. Orang yang membuat teh sebaiknya tidak menambah terlalu banyak gula. Sajikan di ruangan tempat semua orang menunggu.

qs.exp: Teks: "in the room where everyone is waiting".
options: In the room where everyone is waiting
In the kitchen near the stove
Outside the house in the yard
In the garden with the guests
qs.q: Where should you serve the tea?

options: Use a cup who is clean.
Use a cup that is clean.
Boil the water in a kettle which has a lid.
The person who makes the tea should add little sugar.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Serve it in the room ___ everyone is waiting."
The person ___ makes the tea should not add much sugar.
Add tea leaves ___ are dry.

qs.answer: Use a cup that is clean.
qs.exp: Urutan: Use a cup that is clean.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Pakai cangkir yang bersih."

read.text: Boil the water in a kettle which has a lid. Use a cup that is clean. Add tea leaves which are dry. The person who makes the tea should not add too much sugar. Serve it in the room where everyone is waiting.
read.title: How to Make Tea

read.focus: Passive voice: is/are/was/were/will be/has been + V3
read.id: Pertama, kertas dipotong berbentuk belah ketupat. Lalu dua batang bambu diikat bersama. Kertas direkatkan pada batang. Tali panjang dipasang, dan ekor ditambahkan. Terakhir, layang-layang diterbangkan di lapangan terbuka.

qs.q: Where is the kite flown?

options: The paper is glued to the sticks.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Two sticks ___ tied together."
The kite is ___ in an open field.
A long string is ___.

qs.answer: The paper is glued to the sticks.
qs.exp: Urutan: The paper is glued to the sticks.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Kertas direkatkan pada batang."

read.text: First, the paper is cut into a diamond shape. Then two sticks are tied together. The paper is glued to the sticks. A long string is attached, and the tail is added. Finally, the kite is flown in an open field.
read.title: How to Make a Kite

read.focus: Reported speech: said, told, asked, suggested
read.id: Dina: Instruktur menyuruh kami merebus air dulu. Dia bilang kami sebaiknya tidak menambah terlalu banyak gula. Tom bertanya apakah teh harus dingin. Instruktur menjawab teh harus panas. Dia menyarankan kami menunggu beberapa menit.

qs.q: What did the instructor say about the tea?

options: He said that we should not to add too much sugar.
He said that we should not add too much sugar.
The instructor told us to boil the water.
He advised us to wait a few minutes.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "The instructor told us ___ boil the water first."
Tom asked if the tea ___ to be cold.
He advised us ___ wait a few minutes.

qs.answer: The instructor answered that it had to be hot.
qs.exp: Urutan: The instructor answered that it had to be hot.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Instruktur menjawab teh harus panas."

read.text: Dina: The instructor told us to boil the water first. He said that we should not add too much sugar. Tom asked if the tea had to be cold. The instructor answered that it had to be hot. He advised us to wait a few minutes.
read.title: Procedure Talk

read.id: Cara termudah membuat teh adalah merebus air dulu. Cangkir yang lebih kecil mendingin lebih cepat daripada yang lebih besar. Semakin panas airnya, semakin kuat tehnya. Daun segar lebih baik daripada yang tua. Resep paling sederhana sering kali yang terbaik.

qs.exp: Teks: "The easiest way ... is to boil water first".
qs.q: What is the easiest way to make tea?

options: A smaller cup cools more fast than a bigger one.
A smaller cup cools faster than a bigger one.
The simplest recipes are often the best.
Fresh leaves are better than old ones.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "The ___ way to make tea is to boil water."
The hotter the water, the ___ the tea.
Fresh leaves are ___ than old ones.

qs.answer: Fresh leaves are better than old ones.
qs.exp: Urutan: Fresh leaves are better than old ones.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Daun segar lebih baik daripada yang tua."

read.text: The easiest way to make tea is to boil water first. A smaller cup cools faster than a bigger one. The hotter the water, the stronger the tea. Fresh leaves are better than old ones. The simplest recipes are often the best.
read.title: A Procedure

read.id: Pertama, kamu perlu merebus air. Pakai sendok untuk mengaduk gula. Hati-hati jangan sampai terbakar. Terus aduk selama dua menit. Lalu berhenti memanaskan dan biarkan mendingin.

qs.q: What should you keep doing for two minutes?

options: Keep to stir for two minutes.
You need to boil the water.
Use a spoon to stir the sugar.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "You need ___ the water."

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan to stir atau stirring:
qs.q: Use a spoon ___ the sugar.

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan stirring atau to stir:
qs.q: Keep ___ for two minutes.

qs.answer: Be careful not to burn yourself.
qs.exp: Urutan: Be careful not to burn yourself.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Hati-hati jangan sampai terbakar."

read.text: First, you need to boil the water. Use a spoon to stir the sugar. Be careful not to burn yourself. Keep stirring for two minutes. Then stop heating and let it cool.
read.title: Procedure
